The words I most wanted to say

A letter, with
an open hand.

Dear you,

On your birthday, I hope you are surrounded by the kind of happiness you give to other people so naturally. I hope this new year of your life is gentle with you, surprises you beautifully, and gives you every reason to smile that impossible-to-ignore smile of yours.

I know our story holds both tenderness and hurt. My ego and the way I treated you caused pain you never deserved. Your forgiveness is something I carry with humility; it does not erase what happened, and I will never use it as permission to ask more from you.

So this page is not me asking you to return. I know I am in no position to ask that of you after what you went through beside me. Wherever life has taken your heart—and whoever now brings joy to it—I genuinely want that joy to be safe, steady, and true.

I only wanted you to know that you remain deeply precious to me. My care for you is not a bargain. It asks for no answer and carries no condition. If life ever becomes difficult, if you need a familiar voice, or if you simply want someone in your corner, you will find me there—with respect for your boundaries, and with nothing demanded in return.

You are not my entire world because you owe me a place in yours. You are part of how I learned what it means for another person to matter so completely. Knowing you changed the landscape of my heart, and for that, I will always be grateful.

Happy birthday, beautiful soul.

Always rooting for you.

My wish for your next chapter

May you always choose
the life that chooses you.

May it be full of soft mornings, brave decisions, loud laughter, people who honour your heart, and a thousand reasons to feel proud of the person you are becoming.

Made with a full heart, for yours.
